column1: # Within-AFM duplicate datings, 430-760: the holdout comparison class.
# AFM has no alternative-source marker stratum to drive the procedure used on
# the other four witnesses (that absence is the P1 result), so this class was
# built by within-witness near-duplicate matching at cos >= 0.45 -- 95 candidate
# pairs, every one read (results/afm_dupe_audit.txt).  Nine non-Patrician
# clusters survive.  The 86 rejects are overwhelmingly successive office-holders
# of one monastery and successive members of one lineage, which is the same
# ~1/15 precision this matcher has within a witness anywhere.
# `cross` records what AU/AT/CS/AI do with the same event, checked by direct
# search: it is how a genuine duplication is told from two people.
# event
Feast of Teamhair by Oilioll Molt
Battle of Dumha Aichir
Ailill bishop of Ard Macha of the Ui Bresail
Feast of Teamhair by Diarmaid son of Cerball
Death of Ronan son of Colman king of Laigin
Death of Blathmac son of Maelcobha king of Ulaid
Death of Bran Finn son of Maelochtraigh
Death of Ceallach son of Raghallach king of Connacht
Death of Seachnasach son of Colgan
